scientific.integrity: All claimed thresholds follow from exact sign-separated equilibrium equations and a cubic Routh-Hurwitz calculation. The nonsmooth origin is handled by a half-space unstable-manifold argument rather than by applying a smooth Hopf theorem.
scientific.limitations: The result treats one parameter slice and proves equilibrium existence, origin instability, and linear spectral geometry. It does not assert a nondegenerate Hopf periodic-orbit bifurcation at the exact negative-branch crossing and does not establish chaos or multistability.

title: Exact equilibrium geometry and a nonsmooth obstruction to the reported origin Hopf transition
